verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs say it captures every session, trace, and span once instrumented. Its SDK logs spans via a `@log` decorator, spans sharing a trace ID are joined into a single trace even across processes, and multi-agent LangGraph tutorials show session-level views of multi-step agent runs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parent-child span nesting depth, any mention of 'threads' as a grouping concept, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
